g.text: Payment capture gateway — Processes and Capabilities
One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A
long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Open and fund direct deposit account
Process CD maturity, renewal, and early withdrawal
Bill installment loan and post payments
Process returned payment and assess NSF
Refund credit balance and report unclaimed property
